    'addLimitMessage', state.add_limit_message, 'addLimitResetsLabel', state.add_limit_resets_label)                 FROM public.get_member_transaction_state(p_member_id, p_league_id) state
SELECT *             FROM public.league_members WHERE id = p_member_id AND league_id = p_league_id AND user_id = auth.uid()
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.league_members WHERE id = target AND league_id = p_league_id)

SELECT
    v_season_id,
    v_week,
    league.weekly_add_limit,
    COALESCE(count_row.add_count, 0),
    league.waiver_mode,
    league.faab_starting_budget,
    COALESCE(balance_row.balance, league.faab_starting_budget, 100) - (
      SELECT COALESCE(sum(item.faab_amount), 0)::int
      FROM trade_items AS item
      JOIN trades AS trade ON trade.id = item.trade_id
      WHERE trade.league_id = p_league_id
        AND trade.league_season_id = v_season_id
        AND trade.status = 'accepted'
        AND item.from_member_id = p_member_id
    ),
    v_resets_at,
    private.weekly_add_limit_message(COALESCE(count_row.add_count, 0), league.weekly_add_limit, v_resets_at),
    private.weekly_add_limit_reset_label(v_resets_at)
  FROM leagues AS league
  LEFT JOIN weekly_add_counts AS count_row
    ON count_row.league_id = league.id
   AND count_row.league_season_id = v_season_id
   AND count_row.member_id = p_member_id
   AND count_row.week_number = v_week
  LEFT JOIN faab_balances AS balance_row
    ON balance_row.league_id = league.id
   AND balance_row.league_season_id = v_season_id
   AND balance_row.member_id = p_member_id
  WHERE league.id = p_league_id
SELECT *             FROM public.leagues WHERE id = p_league_id AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('assetKind',asset_kind,'assetId',asset_id,
    'sourceKind',source_kind,'sourceId',source_id,'reason',reason) ORDER BY source_kind,source_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                     FROM private.locked_assets(p_league_id,(context->>'seasonId')::uuid,p_member_id)
    WHERE target=p_member_id

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN p_view IN ('today', 'week_avg', 'week_total') THEN p_view ELSE 'today' END AS view_name,
    COALESCE(p_game_date, (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date) AS game_date,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 600), 1), 1000) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
league AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    scoring_settings,
    (
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0
    ) AS uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  FROM public.leagues
  WHERE id = p_league_id
),
week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT 1
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM public.players p
  WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_player_ids)
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng
    ON ng.game_date >= args.game_date
   AND ng.status NOT IN ('InProgress', 'Final')
   AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT home_team AS nba_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
  ) g ON g.nba_team = teams.nba_team
  ORDER BY teams.nba_team, g.game_date ASC, g.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, g.id ASC
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN 'vs ' || COALESCE(g.away_team, '?')
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN '@ ' || COALESCE(g.home_team, '?')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_total'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    'fantasypros_daily'::text AS projection_source,
    'FantasyPros Daily'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'today'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    1 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '36 hours'
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = 'today'
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'fantasypros_weekly_avg_total'
      ELSE 'fantasypros_weekly_avg'
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'FantasyPros Week Avg x GP'
      ELSE 'FantasyPros Week Avg'
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'week_total'
      ELSE 'week_avg'
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 2 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 3 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_avg' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = r.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(r.games_played, 0), wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  WHERE args.view_name IN ('today', 'week_avg', 'week_total')
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_total_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    'fantasypros_weekly_total'::text AS projection_source,
    'FantasyPros Week Total'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'week_total'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, 0) > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 2 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE 0
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, 0) > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 3 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE 0
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    1 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_total'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_total_run lwtr
    ON lwtr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = 'week_total'
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
internal_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.player_id)
    pp.player_id,
    'internal'::text AS projection_source,
    'Internal Projection'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'fallback'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_double_doubles, 0) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_double_doubles
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_triple_doubles, 0) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_triple_doubles
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    pp.projected_minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE NULL::int END AS projection_games_played,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status,
    pp.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    NULL::date AS projection_date,
    pp.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    3 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.player_projections pp
    ON pp.season_year = p_season_year
   AND pp.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND pp.projected_stat_points IS NOT NULL
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = pp.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = pp.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  ORDER BY pp.player_id, pp.fetched_at DESC
),
season_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    avg.player_id,
    'season_avg'::text AS projection_source,
    'Season Avg'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'fallback'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) > 0
        THEN COALESCE(avg.double_doubles, 0)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE 0 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) > 0
        THEN COALESCE(avg.triple_doubles, 0)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE 0 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_minutes_played * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE avg.games_played::int END AS projection_games_played,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status,
    NULL::timestamptz AS projection_fetched_at,
    NULL::date AS projection_date,
    NULL::int AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    4 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages avg
    ON avg.season_year = p_season_year
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = avg.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = avg.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
),
candidate_union AS (
  SELECT * FROM daily_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_total_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_avg_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM internal_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM season_avg_candidates
),
fallback_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cu.player_id) cu.*
  FROM candidate_union cu
  ORDER BY cu.player_id, cu.priority ASC, cu.projection_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
sleeper_games AS (
  SELECT r.*, public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
    r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
    r.field_goals_made, r.field_goals_attempted, r.free_throws_made, r.free_throws_attempted,
    r.double_doubles, r.triple_doubles, l.scoring_settings
  ) AS fantasy_points, r.team IS DISTINCT FROM bp.nba_team AS prior_team_game
  FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows r
  JOIN base_players bp ON bp.id = r.player_id
  LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id=bp.id
  JOIN league l ON true
  CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  WHERE r.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (r.game_date<(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date OR r.team=bp.nba_team)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT game_date,home_team AS team,away_team AS opponent FROM regular_games
      UNION ALL SELECT game_date,away_team,home_team FROM regular_games
    ) g WHERE g.game_date=r.game_date AND g.team=r.team AND g.opponent=r.opponent)
    AND (args.view_name = 'today' AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)
      OR args.view_name <> 'today' AND r.week_number = wc.week_number)
),
sleeper_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id, count(*)::integer AS games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE prior_team_game)::integer AS prior_team_games,
    sum(fantasy_points) AS fantasy_points,
    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    100 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),0) AS field_goal_pct,
    100 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),0) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id
),
sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, 'sleeper'::text AS projection_source, 'Sleeper (RotoWire)'::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor,2) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN s.game_date ELSE NULL::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval '36 hours' AS projection_is_fresh, 0 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,0)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,0) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_total' THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,0)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_avg' THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM sleeper_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT b.* FROM fallback_best b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sleeper_candidates s WHERE s.player_id=b.player_id)
)

v_stats_season := COALESCE(p_season_year, CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT $62
  FROM public.nba_games g
  WHERE g.season_year = v_current_season
    AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(g.nba_game_id)
    AND (g.status = $63 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT $64 FROM public.player_game_stats s
      WHERE s.game_id = g.id
        AND NOT s.did_not_play
        AND (s.minutes_played > $65 OR s.points > $66 OR s.rebounds > $67
          OR s.assists > $68 OR s.steals > $69 OR s.blocks > $70
          OR s.turnovers > $71 OR s.field_goals_attempted > $72
          OR s.free_throws_attempted > $73)
    ))
) THEN v_current_season ELSE v_current_season - $74 END)
jsonb_build_object($7, context, $8, claims)

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_query, $62)), $63) AS query_text,
    CASE COALESCE(p_position, $64)
      WHEN $65 THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
      WHEN $66 THEN ARRAY[$67, $68]::text[]
      WHEN $69 THEN ARRAY[$70, $71]::text[]
      ELSE ARRAY[p_position]::text[]
    END AS pos_filter,
    CASE
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, $72)) > $73 THEN
          ARRAY(
            SELECT explicit_team
            FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_teams, $74)) AS explicit_team
            WHERE explicit_team = ANY(COALESCE(p_playing_teams, $75))
            ORDER BY explicit_team
          )
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p_playing_teams, $76)
      ELSE COALESCE(p_teams, $77)
    END AS effective_teams,
    (p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, $78)) > $79) AS team_filter_active,
    COALESCE(p_excluded_teams, $80) AS excluded_teams,
    COALESCE(p_exclude_player_ids, $81) AS exclude_player_ids,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, $82), $83), $84) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, $85), $86) AS page_offset
),
current_averages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cached.player_id, cached.season_year, cached.avg_fantasy_points,
    (cached.averages->>$87)::numeric AS avg_points,
    (cached.averages->>$88)::numeric AS avg_rebounds,
    (cached.averages->>$89)::numeric AS avg_assists,
    (cached.averages->>$90)::numeric AS avg_steals,
    (cached.averages->>$91)::numeric AS avg_blocks,
    (cached.averages->>$92)::numeric AS avg_turnovers,
    (cached.averages->>$93)::numeric AS avg_three_pointers_made,
    (cached.averages->>$94)::numeric AS avg_minutes_played,
    (cached.averages->>$95)::integer AS games_played
  FROM public.player_season_averages cached
  WHERE cached.league_id = p_league_id AND cached.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season = v_current_season AND cached.averages IS NOT NULL
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR cached.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
season_averages AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM public.mv_player_season_averages
  WHERE season_year = v_stats_season AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
),
league_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR fp.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
score_source AS (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND NOT COALESCE(p_health IN ($96, $97, $98, $99), $100)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM league_scores AS fp
  WHERE p_health IN ($101, $102, $103, $104)
),
filtered_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws($105, p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.status,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id,
    p.years_exp,
    p.dynasty_rank,
    p.career_regular_season_games,
    p.birthdate,
    p.injury_reason,
    p.injury_expected_return,
    fp.avg_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists,
    avg.avg_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks,
    avg.avg_turnovers,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_minutes_played,
    avg.games_played::int AS games_played
  FROM args
  JOIN public.players AS p ON $106
  LEFT JOIN season_averages AS avg
    ON avg.player_id = p.id
   AND avg.season_year = v_stats_season
  LEFT JOIN score_source AS fp
    ON fp.player_id = p.id
  WHERE
    (args.query_text IS NULL OR p.display_name ILIKE ($107 || args.query_text || $108))
    AND (cardinality(args.pos_filter) = $109 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT $110
      FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS player_position
      WHERE player_position::text = ANY(args.pos_filter)
    ))
    AND (NOT args.team_filter_active OR (cardinality(args.effective_teams) > $111 AND p.nba_team = ANY(args.effective_teams)))
    AND (cardinality(args.excluded_teams) = $112 OR p.nba_team IS NULL OR p.nba_team <> ALL(args.excluded_teams))
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
    AND (cardinality(args.exclude_player_ids) = $113 OR p.id <> ALL(args.exclude_player_ids))
    AND (NOT p_rookies_only OR p.years_exp = $114)
    AND CASE COALESCE(p_health, $115)
      WHEN $116 THEN p.injury_status IS NULL
      WHEN $117 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$118, $119, $120, $121])
      WHEN $122 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$123, $124, $125])
      WHEN $126 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$127, $128])
      ELSE $129
    END
),
paged_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      filtered_base.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $130 THEN filtered_base.dynasty_rank END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $131 AND filtered_base.dynasty_rank IS NULL THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $132 AND p_sort_dir = $133 THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $134 AND p_sort_dir <> $135 THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $136 AND p_sort_dir = $137 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, $138) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $139 AND p_sort_dir <> $140 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, $141) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $142 AND p_sort_dir = $143 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, $144) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $145 AND p_sort_dir <> $146 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, $147) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $148 AND p_sort_dir = $149 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, $150) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $151 AND p_sort_dir <> $152 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, $153) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $154 AND p_sort_dir = $155 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, $156) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $157 AND p_sort_dir <> $158 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, $159) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $160 AND p_sort_dir = $161 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, $162) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $163 AND p_sort_dir <> $164 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, $165) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $166 AND p_sort_dir = $167 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, $168) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $169 AND p_sort_dir <> $170 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, $171) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $172 AND p_sort_dir = $173 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, $174) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $175 AND p_sort_dir <> $176 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, $177) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $178 AND p_sort_dir = $179 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, $180) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $181 AND p_sort_dir <> $182 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, $183) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $184 AND p_sort_dir = $185 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, $186) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $187 AND p_sort_dir <> $188 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, $189) END DESC,
          filtered_base.display_name ASC,
          filtered_base.id ASC
      ) AS page_rank
    FROM filtered_base
  ) ranked_base
  ORDER BY page_rank
  LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
  OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)
),
projection AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.get_league_projection_rows(
    p_league_id,

    (timezone($190, now()))::date,

    (SELECT page_limit FROM args),

  )

WITH assignments AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT player_id, slot_type FROM public.weekly_lineups WHERE member_id = target AND league_id = p_league_id
      AND league_season_id = (context->>$10)::uuid AND game_date = selected
  ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM public.roster_players WHERE member_id = target AND league_id = p_league_id AND league_season_id = (context->>$11)::uuid
  ), players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.id, r.is_on_ir, r.is_on_taxi, r.id AS roster_id, jsonb_build_object($12, COALESCE(r.id::text, $13),
      $14, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(lock) FROM jsonb_array_elements(asset_locks) lock WHERE lock->>$15=$16 AND lock->>$17=p.id::text),$18), $19, p.id, $20, COALESCE(p.display_name, $21), $22, p.position,
      $23, CASE WHEN cardinality(p.eligible_positions) > $24 THEN to_jsonb(p.eligible_positions)
        WHEN p.position IS NULL THEN $25::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array(p.position) END,
      $26, p.nba_team, $27, p.years_exp, $28, p.career_regular_season_games,
      $29, p.injury_status, $30, p.nba_id) AS data
    FROM public.players p LEFT JOIN roster r ON r.player_id = p.id
    WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT $31 FROM assignments a WHERE a.player_id = p.id)
  ), placed AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.slot_type ORDER BY a.player_id) AS slot_number
    FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN roster r ON r.player_id = a.player_id
    WHERE a.slot_type NOT IN ($32, $33) AND (selected <= today OR NOT COALESCE(r.is_on_ir OR r.is_on_taxi, $34))
  ), occupied AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t.slot_type, sequence.number, player.data, player.id FROM public.lineup_slot_templates t
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series($35, t.slot_count) sequence(number)
      LEFT JOIN placed a ON a.slot_type = t.slot_type AND a.slot_number = sequence.number
      LEFT JOIN players player ON player.id = a.player_id
    WHERE t.league_id = p_league_id AND t.slot_type NOT IN ($36, $37)
  )
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($38, slot_type, $39, data) ORDER BY slot_type, number) FROM occupied), $40),
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p.data ORDER BY p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.roster_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.is_on_ir AND NOT p.is_on_taxi

week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT $30
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws($31, p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM public.players p
  WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_player_ids)
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng
    ON ng.game_date >= args.game_date
   AND ng.status NOT IN ($32, $33)
   AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT home_team AS nba_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
  ) g ON g.nba_team = teams.nba_team
  ORDER BY teams.nba_team, g.game_date ASC, g.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, g.id ASC
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN $34 || COALESCE(g.away_team, $35)
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN $36 || COALESCE(g.home_team, $37)
      ELSE $38
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON $39
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $40
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $41
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = $42
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $43
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $44
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $45
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $46
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $47
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $48
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $49
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $50
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $51
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $52
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $53
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $54::text AS projection_source,
    $55::text AS projection_source_label,
    $56::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $57::numeric, $58::numeric, $59::numeric, $60::numeric, $61::numeric, $62::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $63 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $64 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $65
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $66
   AND r.match_status = $67
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $68
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $69
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = $70
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $71 THEN $72
      ELSE $73
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $74 THEN $75
      ELSE $76
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $77 THEN $78
      ELSE $79
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      $80::numeric,
      $81::numeric,
      $82::numeric,
      $83::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $84 AND m.games_multiplier > $85 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $86) >= $87)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $88) >= $89)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $90) >= $91)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $92) >= $93)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $94) >= $95)::int
        ) >= $96 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $97 THEN $98::numeric
        ELSE $99::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $100 AND m.games_multiplier > $101 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $102) >= $103)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $104) >= $105)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $106) >= $107)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $108) >= $109)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $110) >= $111)::int
        ) >= $112 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $113 THEN $114::numeric
        ELSE $115::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $116 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $117 AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $118 THEN $119 ELSE $120 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $121
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $122
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $123
   AND r.match_status = $124
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $125
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $126
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = r.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $127 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(r.games_played, $128), wgc.scheduled_games, $129)::numeric
      ELSE $130::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  WHERE args.view_name IN ($131, $132, $133)
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_total_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $134::text AS projection_source,
    $135::text AS projection_source_label,
    $136::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $137::numeric, $138::numeric, $139::numeric, $140::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $141) > $142 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $143) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $144) >= $145)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $146) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $147) >= $148)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $149) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $150) >= $151)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $152) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $153) >= $154)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $155) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $156) >= $157)::int
        ) >= $158 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $159
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $160) > $161 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $162) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $163) >= $164)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $165) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $166) >= $167)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $168) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $169) >= $170)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $171) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $172) >= $173)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $174) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $175) >= $176)::int
        ) >= $177 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $178
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $179 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $180 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $181
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $182
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $183
   AND r.match_status = $184
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $185
  JOIN latest_weekly_total_run lwtr
    ON lwtr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $186
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = $187
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
internal_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.player_id)
    pp.player_id,
    $188::text AS projection_source,
    $189::text AS projection_source_label,
    $190::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $191 THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_double_doubles, $192) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_double_doubles
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $193 THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_triple_doubles, $194) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_triple_doubles
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    pp.projected_minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $195 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE $196::int END AS projection_games_played,
    $197::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    $198::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $199::text AS projection_status,
    pp.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    $200::date AS projection_date,
    pp.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $201 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $202 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON $203
  JOIN league l ON $204
  JOIN public.player_projections pp
    ON pp.season_year = p_season_year
   AND pp.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND pp.projected_stat_points IS NOT NULL
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = pp.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = pp.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $205 THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, $206)::numeric
      ELSE $207::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  ORDER BY pp.player_id, pp.fetched_at DESC
),
season_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    avg.player_id,
    $208::text AS projection_source,
    $209::text AS projection_source_label,
    $210::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, $211) > $212
        THEN COALESCE(avg.double_doubles, $213)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE $214 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, $215) > $216
        THEN COALESCE(avg.triple_doubles, $217)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE $218 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_minutes_played * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $219 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE avg.games_played::int END AS projection_games_played,
    $220::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    $221::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $222::text AS projection_status,
    $223::timestamptz AS projection_fetched_at,
    $224::date AS projection_date,
    $225::int AS projection_week_number,
    $226 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $227 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $228
  JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages avg
    ON avg.season_year = p_season_year
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = avg.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = avg.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $229 THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, $230)::numeric
      ELSE $231::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
),
candidate_union AS (
  SELECT * FROM daily_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_total_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_avg_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM internal_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM season_avg_candidates
),
fallback_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cu.player_id) cu.*
  FROM candidate_union cu
  ORDER BY cu.player_id, cu.priority ASC, cu.projection_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
sleeper_games AS (
  SELECT r.*, public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
    r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
    r.field_goals_made, r.field_goals_attempted, r.free_throws_made, r.free_throws_attempted,
    r.double_doubles, r.triple_doubles, l.scoring_settings
  ) AS fantasy_points, r.team IS DISTINCT FROM bp.nba_team AS prior_team_game
  FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows r
  JOIN base_players bp ON bp.id = r.player_id
  LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id=bp.id
  JOIN league l ON $232
  CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $233
  WHERE r.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (r.game_date<(now() AT TIME ZONE $234)::date OR r.team=bp.nba_team)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT $235 FROM (
      SELECT game_date,home_team AS team,away_team AS opponent FROM regular_games
      UNION ALL SELECT game_date,away_team,home_team FROM regular_games
    ) g WHERE g.game_date=r.game_date AND g.team=r.team AND g.opponent=r.opponent)
    AND (args.view_name = $236 AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)
      OR args.view_name <> $237 AND r.week_number = wc.week_number)
),
sleeper_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id, count(*)::integer AS games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE prior_team_game)::integer AS prior_team_games,
    sum(fantasy_points) AS fantasy_points,
    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    $238 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),$239) AS field_goal_pct,
    $240 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),$241) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id
),
sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, $242::text AS projection_source, $243::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,$244)) / m.divisor,$245) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,$246)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,$247)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,$248)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,$249)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,$250)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,$251)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,$252)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,$253)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $254 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,$255)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,$256)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $257 END,$258) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,$259)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,$260)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $261 END,$262) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $263::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name=$264 THEN s.game_date ELSE $265::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval $266 AS projection_is_fresh, $267 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name=$268 THEN $269 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,$270)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,$271) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$272 THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,$273)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$274 THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE $275 END
        ELSE $276 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM sleeper_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT b.* FROM fallback_best b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT $277 FROM sleeper_candidates s WHERE s.player_id=b.player_id)
)

v_stats_season := COALESCE(p_season_year, CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.nba_games g
  WHERE g.season_year = v_current_season
    AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(g.nba_game_id)
    AND (g.status = 'Final' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.player_game_stats s
      WHERE s.game_id = g.id
        AND NOT s.did_not_play
        AND (s.minutes_played > 0 OR s.points > 0 OR s.rebounds > 0
          OR s.assists > 0 OR s.steals > 0 OR s.blocks > 0
          OR s.turnovers > 0 OR s.field_goals_attempted > 0
          OR s.free_throws_attempted > 0)
    ))
) THEN v_current_season ELSE v_current_season - 1 END)

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_query, '')), '') AS query_text,
    CASE COALESCE(p_position, 'ALL')
      WHEN 'ALL' THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
      WHEN 'G' THEN ARRAY['PG', 'SG']::text[]
      WHEN 'F' THEN ARRAY['SF', 'PF']::text[]
      ELSE ARRAY[p_position]::text[]
    END AS pos_filter,
    CASE
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0 THEN
          ARRAY(
            SELECT explicit_team
            FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) AS explicit_team
            WHERE explicit_team = ANY(COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}'))
            ORDER BY explicit_team
          )
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p_playing_teams, '{}')
      ELSE COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')
    END AS effective_teams,
    (p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, '{}')) > 0) AS team_filter_active,
    COALESCE(p_excluded_teams, '{}') AS excluded_teams,
    COALESCE(p_exclude_player_ids, '{}') AS exclude_player_ids,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 1), 100) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
current_averages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cached.player_id, cached.season_year, cached.avg_fantasy_points,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_points')::numeric AS avg_points,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_rebounds')::numeric AS avg_rebounds,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_assists')::numeric AS avg_assists,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_steals')::numeric AS avg_steals,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_blocks')::numeric AS avg_blocks,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_turnovers')::numeric AS avg_turnovers,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_three_pointers_made')::numeric AS avg_three_pointers_made,
    (cached.averages->>'avg_minutes_played')::numeric AS avg_minutes_played,
    (cached.averages->>'games_played')::integer AS games_played
  FROM public.player_season_averages cached
  WHERE cached.league_id = p_league_id AND cached.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season = v_current_season AND cached.averages IS NOT NULL
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR cached.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
season_averages AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    player_id,
    season_year,
    avg_points,
    avg_rebounds,
    avg_assists,
    avg_steals,
    avg_blocks,
    avg_turnovers,
    avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg_minutes_played,
    games_played
  FROM public.mv_player_season_averages
  WHERE season_year = v_stats_season AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
),
league_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR fp.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
score_source AS (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points FROM current_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = v_stats_season
    AND v_stats_season <> v_current_season
    AND NOT COALESCE(p_health IN ('healthy', 'gtd', 'out', 'ir'), false)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM league_scores AS fp
  WHERE p_health IN ('healthy', 'gtd', 'out', 'ir')
),
filtered_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.status,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id,
    p.years_exp,
    p.dynasty_rank,
    p.career_regular_season_games,
    p.birthdate,
    p.injury_reason,
    p.injury_expected_return,
    fp.avg_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists,
    avg.avg_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks,
    avg.avg_turnovers,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_minutes_played,
    avg.games_played::int AS games_played
  FROM args
  JOIN public.players AS p ON true
  LEFT JOIN season_averages AS avg
    ON avg.player_id = p.id
   AND avg.season_year = v_stats_season
  LEFT JOIN score_source AS fp
    ON fp.player_id = p.id
  WHERE
    (args.query_text IS NULL OR p.display_name ILIKE ('%' || args.query_text || '%'))
    AND (cardinality(args.pos_filter) = 0 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS player_position
      WHERE player_position::text = ANY(args.pos_filter)
    ))
    AND (NOT args.team_filter_active OR (cardinality(args.effective_teams) > 0 AND p.nba_team = ANY(args.effective_teams)))
    AND (cardinality(args.excluded_teams) = 0 OR p.nba_team IS NULL OR p.nba_team <> ALL(args.excluded_teams))
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
    AND (cardinality(args.exclude_player_ids) = 0 OR p.id <> ALL(args.exclude_player_ids))
    AND (NOT p_rookies_only OR p.years_exp = 0)
    AND CASE COALESCE(p_health, 'all')
      WHEN 'healthy' THEN p.injury_status IS NULL
      WHEN 'gtd' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['GTD', 'DTD', 'Questionable', 'Game Time Decision'])
      WHEN 'out' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['Out', 'OUT', 'O'])
      WHEN 'ir' THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY['IR', 'IR-LTI'])
      ELSE true
    END
),
paged_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      filtered_base.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' THEN filtered_base.dynasty_rank END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'dynasty' AND filtered_base.dynasty_rank IS NULL THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'fpts' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END ASC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'fpts' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points END DESC NULLS LAST,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'min' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'min' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'pts' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'pts' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'reb' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'ast' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'stl' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'blk' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'tpm' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'to' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, 0) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = 'gp' AND p_sort_dir <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, 0) END DESC,
          filtered_base.display_name ASC,
          filtered_base.id ASC
      ) AS page_rank
    FROM filtered_base
  ) ranked_base
  ORDER BY page_rank
  LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
  OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)
),
projection AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.get_league_projection_rows(
    p_league_id,
    v_stats_season,
    (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date,
    'today',
    COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(paged_base.id ORDER BY paged_base.id) FROM paged_base), ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
    (SELECT page_limit FROM args),
    0
  )
  WHERE p_league_id IS NOT NULL
)

WITH assignments AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT player_id, slot_type FROM public.weekly_lineups WHERE member_id = target AND league_id = p_league_id
      AND league_season_id = (context->>'seasonId')::uuid AND game_date = selected
  ), roster AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM public.roster_players WHERE member_id = target AND league_id = p_league_id AND league_season_id = (context->>'seasonId')::uuid
  ), players AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.id, r.is_on_ir, r.is_on_taxi, r.id AS roster_id, jsonb_build_object('rosterPlayerId', COALESCE(r.id::text, ''),
      'assetLocks', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(lock) FROM jsonb_array_elements(asset_locks) lock WHERE lock->>'assetKind'='player' AND lock->>'assetId'=p.id::text),'[]'), 'playerId', p.id, 'displayName', COALESCE(p.display_name, ''), 'position', p.position,
      'eligiblePositions', CASE WHEN cardinality(p.eligible_positions) > 0 THEN to_jsonb(p.eligible_positions)
        WHEN p.position IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array(p.position) END,
      'nbaTeam', p.nba_team, 'yearsExp', p.years_exp, 'careerGames', p.career_regular_season_games,
      'injuryStatus', p.injury_status, 'nbaId', p.nba_id) AS data
    FROM public.players p LEFT JOIN roster r ON r.player_id = p.id
    WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a WHERE a.player_id = p.id)
  ), placed AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.slot_type ORDER BY a.player_id) AS slot_number
    FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN roster r ON r.player_id = a.player_id
    WHERE a.slot_type NOT IN ('BE', 'IR') AND (selected <= today OR NOT COALESCE(r.is_on_ir OR r.is_on_taxi, false))
  ), occupied AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t.slot_type, sequence.number, player.data, player.id FROM public.lineup_slot_templates t
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, t.slot_count) sequence(number)
      LEFT JOIN placed a ON a.slot_type = t.slot_type AND a.slot_number = sequence.number
      LEFT JOIN players player ON player.id = a.player_id
    WHERE t.league_id = p_league_id AND t.slot_type NOT IN ('BE', 'IR')
  )
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slotType', slot_type, 'player', data) ORDER BY slot_type, number) FROM occupied), '[]'),
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p.data ORDER BY p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.roster_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.is_on_ir AND NOT p.is_on_taxi
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occupied o WHERE o.id = p.id)
      AND NOT (selected < today AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.roster_transactions transaction
        WHERE transaction.member_id = target AND transaction.league_id = p_league_id AND transaction.league_season_id = (context->>'seasonId')::uuid
          AND transaction.player_id = p.id AND transaction.transaction_type IN ('fa_add', 'waiver_add', 'trade_in', 'draft_won', 'carry_over')
          AND transaction.occurred_at > ((selected + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - interval '1 millisecond'))), '[]'),
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p.data ORDER BY p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.is_on_ir AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occupied o WHERE o.id = p.id)), '[]'),
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p.data ORDER BY p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.is_on_taxi AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occupied o WHERE o.id = p.id)), '[]')
                                 FROM players p

WITH category_counts AS (
    SELECT (
      (COALESCE(p_points, $15) >= $16)::int +
      (COALESCE(p_rebounds, $17) >= $18)::int +
      (COALESCE(p_assists, $19) >= $20)::int +
      (COALESCE(p_steals, $21) >= $22)::int +
      (COALESCE(p_blocks, $23) >= $24)::int
    ) AS ten_plus_categories
  )
  SELECT ROUND((
    COALESCE(p_points, $25)              * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$26)::numeric, $27) +
    COALESCE(p_rebounds, $28)            * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$29)::numeric, $30) +
    COALESCE(p_assists, $31)             * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$32)::numeric, $33) +
    COALESCE(p_steals, $34)              * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$35)::numeric, $36) +
    COALESCE(p_blocks, $37)              * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$38)::numeric, $39) +
    COALESCE(p_three_pointers_made, $40) * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$41)::numeric, $42) +
    COALESCE(p_turnovers, $43)           * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$44)::numeric, $45) +
    COALESCE(p_field_goals_made, $46)    * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$47)::numeric, $48) +
    COALESCE(p_field_goals_attempted, $49) * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$50)::numeric, $51) +
    COALESCE(p_free_throws_made, $52)    * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$53)::numeric, $54) +
    COALESCE(p_free_throws_attempted, $55) * COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$56)::numeric, $57) +
    COALESCE(p_double_doubles, CASE WHEN ten_plus_categories >= $58 THEN $59 ELSE $60 END) *
      COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$61)::numeric, $62) +
    COALESCE(p_triple_doubles, CASE WHEN ten_plus_categories >= $63 THEN $64 ELSE $65 END) *
      COALESCE((p_scoring_settings->>$66)::numeric, $67)
  ), $68)
  FROM category_counts

WITH active_trades AS (
    SELECT trade.* FROM public.trades trade
    WHERE trade.league_id = p_league_id AND trade.league_season_id = p_league_season_id
      AND trade.status IN ($4, $5)
  ), trade_assets AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN item.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN $6 ELSE $7 END AS kind,
      COALESCE(item.player_id, item.pick_id) AS id, trade.id AS trade_id, trade.status
    FROM active_trades trade JOIN public.trade_items item ON item.trade_id = trade.id
    WHERE item.from_member_id = p_member_id AND COALESCE(item.player_id, item.pick_id) IS NOT NULL
      AND (trade.status = $8 OR trade.proposer_member_id = p_member_id OR EXISTS (
        SELECT $9 FROM public.trade_participants participant WHERE participant.trade_id = trade.id
          AND participant.member_id = p_member_id AND participant.accepted_at IS NOT NULL))
    UNION
    SELECT $10, reserved.id, trade.id, trade.status
    FROM active_trades trade JOIN public.trade_participants participant ON participant.trade_id = trade.id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT unnest(participant.drop_player_ids) AS id
      UNION SELECT (move->>$11)::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(participant.roster_moves) move
    ) reserved
    WHERE participant.member_id = p_member_id
  )
  SELECT kind, id, $12, trade_id,
    format($13, left(trade_id::text, $14),
      CASE WHEN status = $15 THEN $16 ELSE $17 END)
  FROM trade_assets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $18, reserved.id, $19, claim.id,
    format($20, left(claim.id::text, $21))
  FROM public.waiver_claims claim
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(ARRAY[claim.player_id, claim.drop_player_id]) AS id) reserved
  WHERE claim.league_id = p_league_id AND claim.league_season_id = p_league_season_id
    AND claim.member_id = p_member_id AND claim.status = $22 AND reserved.id IS NOT NULL

WITH dates AS (
    SELECT generate_series(CASE WHEN week.week_number = 1 THEN date_trunc('week', week.week_start::timestamp)::date ELSE week.week_start END,

      WHERE week.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer AND week.week_number = (context->>'weekNumber')::integer
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT game.game_date FROM public.nba_games game
      WHERE game.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer AND game.week_number = (context->>'weekNumber')::integer
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.season_weeks week WHERE week.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer
          AND week.week_number = (context->>'weekNumber')::integer)
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', day, 'dayLabel', substring('SMTWTFS', extract(dow FROM day)::integer + 1, 1),
    'dateNum', extract(day FROM day), 'isToday', day = (now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(context->'league'->>'timezone', 'America/Los_Angeles'))::date,
    'hasGames', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.nba_games g WHERE g.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer AND g.game_date = day),
    'playingTeams', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(team ORDER BY game_id, side) FROM (
      SELECT g.id AS game_id, 0 AS side, g.home_team AS team FROM public.nba_games g WHERE g.game_date = day AND g.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer
      UNION ALL SELECT g.id, 1, g.away_team FROM public.nba_games g WHERE g.game_date = day AND g.season_year = (context->>'seasonYear')::integer
    ) teams), '[]')) ORDER BY day), '[]')           FROM dates

      JOIN trades AS trade ON trade.id = item.trade_id
      WHERE trade.league_id = p_league_id
        AND trade.league_season_id = v_season_id

  FROM leagues AS league
